featured_reviews.review_text: Our Lady of Good Counsel Church(OLGC)  is one of the oldest churches in Sion, Mumbai built by the Portuguese. It was built at Sion and was initially affiliated to the St.Michael Church at Mahim in 1596. Our Lady of Good Counsel Convent High School was established in 1939 as primary School later in 1958 as High on the premises of the Church.Its a co-ed school.The school has excellent extra curricular all round activities especially sports,Girls basketball team is well known..The is affiliated to the Maharashtra State Board of Education.

featured_reviews.name: Lizann Lobo
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our Lady of Good Counsel Church in Sion is a beautiful and serene place of worship, offering a quiet space for reflection amidst the hustle and bustle of Mumbai. With its classic architecture, well-maintained interiors, and peaceful ambiance, the church holds a timeless charm that draws both the faithful and visitors alike.

The parish community is warm and welcoming, and the Mass services are reverent and meaningful, often accompanied by soulful choir singing. The church compound is also spacious and clean, providing a calm and spiritual environment.

Whether you're attending Mass, seeking a moment of peace, or simply admiring its heritage, this church is truly a spiritual landmark in the Sion area.

name: Roman Catholic Church Our Lady Of Dolours
description:
The Church of Our Lady of Dolours, Wadala is a Roman Catholic church in Mumbai, India built in 1853. The parish of Our Lady of Dolours with its school, St. Joseph's was entrusted to the Salesians in 1948, about the same time as the Salesians settled in Matunga. The school was co-ed until the Salesian Sisters came into the Wadala Village with the Auxilium Convent for girls. The centerpiece of the church is a statue of the Pieta.

The parish extends till Kings Circle fly-over in the North, Naigaum, Sahakar Nagar and Kidwai Nagar in the South, Hindu Colony/Ruia College in the West and the Harbour Branch Railway line including the Reynold's Road, BPT Quarters in the East.

featured_reviews.name: Joseph D'Cruz
featured_reviews.review_text: This is one of the oldest places in Vakola. This Catholic parish was very large (in terms of members) in the 80's and 90's with almost 30000 families being part of it but due to cost of living going up and real-estate prices going through the roof many have sold their places and moved to the suburbs. Currently the numbers have come down to almost close to 10000 or little above that. Still one of the very active churches in terms of people's participation. There are 5 resident priests allotted to this parish. There's also boys school run by the parish. A very spiritual place and the services are conducted with a lot of vigour and enthusiasm. Truly fulfilling to be part of those.

featured_reviews.name: Ramiah Daniels
featured_reviews.review_text:
A branch of the Rose of Sharon Ministry, this is the second church launched in 2019, and our congregation is blessed to have two churches in Mumbai.
I have been a member of this ministry since 1999, and my family and I have benefitted from the Word of God expounded by our Pastor Saroja M over the years at the Kalina church and now also, at this Kurla church.
Pastor is a mother to all members, even as a hen watches over her brood, praying constantly for our well-being and health and safety. Her counsel, when sought, is priceless, and it is only when one realises that this counsel is not of this world, but from the Spirit of the Lord, that one benefits from her advice and counsel.
A loving, caring, and disciplined Pastor, she will always teach us only as per the Holy Bible. When we receive her correction, it is a blessing, for it helps straighten our paths and keep us on our road to salvation.
Over the last 27 years, we have witnessed many personal miracles, blessings, and mighty deeds of our Lord Jesus in our lives and we owe a lot of this to our Pastor’s teaching, counsel, correction, and fellowship at the Rose of Sharon.
